title: The North Face Vario 23 review: a fast single-wall tent with an exoskeleton frame
dek: A 3 lb 15 oz single-wall tent with DAC reverse-combi poles that owners pitch in about a minute. Condensation is the trade-off.
subject: The North Face Vario 23
verdict: The Vario 23 is a light, very fast single-wall tent with a stable exoskeleton-style pole frame. Two people fit and can sit up. Like most single-wall tents, it builds condensation on the inside walls, so keep the vents open.
bestFor: Two backpackers who value fast setup and low weight, in mostly dry conditions.
notFor: Humid trips, or campers who hate a damp tent wall.

cons: Condensation on interior walls, especially mornings
Vestibules too small to cook in

body:
## The short version

The Vario 23 is a two-person, single-wall tent with three DAC poles in a reverse-combi layout, mixing 9.6 mm and 9 mm diameters. Owners call it light, quick and durable, and the most common complaint is condensation.

## Setup

This is its party trick. One owner timed it at about 60 seconds. It uses snaps and a short top pole on an exoskeleton-style frame, and the vestibules need staking to pull the fabric tight.

## Condensation

Single-wall tents trade weight for breathability, and owners notice. Several report moisture on the interior walls, especially in the morning, even with the top vents. One owner's advice: leave the vents open and you'll be fine.

## Weather and durability

One owner says it stayed dry through a flooded bog. Another reports it was still waterproof four years later, with no rips or tears.

## Space

Two people fit comfortably and can sit upright. Both vestibules hold packs and gear but are too small for cooking.

## Poles and parts

The Vario 23 uses **3 poles**, **9.6 mm and 9 mm** tubing (thicker and thinner poles in the same set), **DAC (reverse combi)**.

The set mixes 9.6 mm and 9 mm poles. Keep them as a matched set, since each diameter goes in a specific position.

The North Face doesn't publish pole lengths. To match a replacement, lay your pole out straight, measure tip to tip, count the sections, and read the diameter printed near a joint (or use calipers). Then search the Vario 23 in our [pole and parts finder](/poles?model=Vario%2023), compare against measured stock in the [pole size chart](/poles/sizes), or search by measurement in [find a pole by size](/poles/size).

## Bottom line

If you want a light tent that's up in a minute, the Vario 23 delivers. Manage the vents and accept some condensation on cold, still nights.
